clauses.title: Number of players
clauses.content: A match is played between two sides, each of eleven players, one of whom shall be captain.

subclauses.content: Each captain shall nominate 11 players plus up to 4 substitute fielders before the toss. No changes without consent.
Only nominated substitutes may act unless exceptional approval is granted.
All nominated players must be eligible and confirm eligibility.
Players agree to ICC regulations including Code of Conduct, Anti-Doping, Anti-Corruption, etc.
Suspended players cannot participate or enter playing area.
Suspended players may remain in dressing room if outside playing area.
Replacement allowed if concussion occurs during play and is medically confirmed.
Conditions may be imposed to avoid unfair advantage.
Decision is final with no appeal.
Replaced player takes no further part.

clauses.title: Captain
clauses.content: Deputy acts if captain unavailable; only nominated players can act post-nomination.

clauses.title: Responsibility of captains
clauses.content: Captains ensure play follows Spirit of Cricket and rules.

clauses.title: Appointment and attendance
clauses.content: Umpires must be impartial and present at least 2 hours before play.
Officials include match referee, two on-field umpires, third umpire, and fourth umpire.
Umpires cannot be changed except in exceptional cases.

clauses.title: Consultation with Home Board
clauses.content: Decide balls, timings, boundaries, covers, and conditions.
Umpires judge fair and unfair play.

clauses.title: Fitness for play
clauses.content: Umpires decide if conditions are safe and reasonable.

clauses.title: Suspension of play
clauses.content: Play is suspended if conditions are dangerous or unreasonable.

clauses.title: Umpire’s decision
clauses.content: Decisions are final unless promptly corrected.
Two scorers record runs, wickets, overs.
Scorers must ensure agreement and consult umpires.
Ball weight: 155.9g–163g; circumference: 22.4–22.9 cm.
Home board supplies approved balls.
New ball at start of each innings.
Ball replaced if lost or unfit.
Bat consists of handle and blade.
Blade must be wood.
Bat must not damage the ball.

clauses.title: Bat size limits
clauses.content: Max length 96.52 cm; width 10.8 cm; depth 6.7 cm.
Pitch length 22 yards, width 10 ft.
Umpires judge pitch fitness.
Ground authority prepares pitch; umpires control use.

clauses.title: Changing the pitch
clauses.content: If unsafe, play stops and may be abandoned or restarted.
Bowling crease marks end of pitch.
Popping crease 4 ft in front of bowling crease.
Return creases at right angles.
Three stumps and two bails; width 22.86 cm.
Stump height 71.12 cm.
Bail dimensions defined.

sections.section: 9 PREPARATION AND MAINTENANCE OF THE PLAYING AREA

clauses.content: Rolling allowed before second innings or delayed start.
Pitch cleared of debris between innings.
Pitch not watered during match.
Pitch protected before match.
Covers must protect pitch and surroundings.
Covers removed before play unless raining.
Intervals include innings break and drinks.
20-minute interval between innings.
Optional drinks break mid-innings.

sections.section: 12 START OF PLAY; CESSATION OF PLAY

clauses.content: Call of Play starts match or resumes play.
Call of Time ends session.
Match ends when result achieved or play cannot continue.
Minimum over rate: 14.11 overs per hour.
